title: Normalized profile
description: Tool-independent form of one profiling run. Every child skill emits this so the root dispatcher can compare, diff, and adjudicate results across tools. Fields a tool cannot measure MUST be null - never estimated.

run_id.description: YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<slug>; matches the runs/ directory name.

phase.description: Which point in the child's loop produced this profile.

variant.description: Variant name when phase is variant/reprofile; null for baseline.

mode.description: Measurement mechanism, e.g. sampling, counters, instrumentation, trace, replay, simulation.

command.description: Verbatim command line used to collect.

overhead_factor.description: Measured profiled_runtime / baseline_runtime for this collection.

multiplexed.description: True if more events were requested than PMU slots, so counts are extrapolated.

exclusive.description: False or null means measurements share the node; widen all intervals.

peak_bandwidth_gbs.description: Measured (e.g. STREAM), not vendor headline, when available.

attributed_s.description: Time successfully attributed to hotspots. Gap vs wall_time_s belongs in warnings.

arithmetic_intensity.description: flops / bytes_dram. Null unless both were measured.

hotspots.description: Ranked by self_time_s, descending. Include enough entries to cover >=80% of attributed time.

name.description: Function, kernel, loop, MPI call, or file.

total_time_s.description: Inclusive of callees. Null if the tool does not do callpath attribution.

samples.description: Sample count; low counts mean a noisy share.

metrics.description: Tool-specific metrics, already converted to schema units. Keys are documented in the child's tool-notes.md metric dictionary.

amdahl_ceiling.description: Max whole-program speedup if this hotspot cost went to zero: 1 / (1 - pct_of_wall/100).

scope.description: Where the class applies: function, kernel, rank, or phase.

evidence.description: Each entry cites a metric THIS tool measured. No inferred mechanisms.

threshold.description: The value that separates classes, and why.

alternatives.description: Classes the evidence does not rule out, with what measurement would discriminate.

kernel_diagnostics.description: Optional bounded kernel-internal capsule, normally profileweaver.ncu-diagnostics/v1. Full counters remain raw artifacts.

warnings.description: Everything that limits trust: unattributed time, broken unwinds, missing symbols, multiplexing error, shared node, inlining collapse, sampling skid, too few samples.

magnitude.description: How much of the result this affects.

raw_artifacts.description: Paths under runs/<run_id>/raw/ that this normalization was derived from.
